slides.title: Looking Ahead
slides.content:
1. The Future Perfect Structure

Use this to talk about an action that will be completed before a specific time in the future.

Subject + WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE
  • "By 2030, we will have doubled our revenue."
  • "By Friday, I will have finished the report."

2. The Magic Word: "BY"

Future Perfect almost always uses the preposition BY (meaning 'no later than').

  • ✅ "By next month..."
  • ✅ "By the time you arrive..."
slides.speech_text: Strategic planning requires vision. We don't just say what we will do; we say what we will have achieved by a certain date. The structure is 'Will Have' plus the Past Participle. For example: 'We will have expanded to Asia by 2028'.

slides.title: The 5-Year Vision
slides.content: Listen to the CEO presenting the roadmap to investors.
slides.audio_script:
Investor: Where do you see the company in five years?
        CEO: That is a great question. By 2028, we will have launched three new products.
        Investor: And what about the debts?
        CEO: By that time, we will have paid off all our startup loans.
        Investor: That sounds ambitious.
        CEO: Yes. We will also have expanded our team to 200 employees.

quiz.question: By 2028, how many products will they have launched?
What will happen to the loans?
options: They will have paid them off

quiz.question: What structure does the CEO use repeatedly?

questions.text: By 5:00 PM today, I _____ the email.
questions.explanation: Hay una fecha límite (By 5:00 PM), así que usamos Futuro Perfecto: 'Will have sent'.

questions.text: Don't worry. By the time you return, we _____ everything.

questions.explanation: El auxiliar siempre es HAVE (nunca 'has' después de will) y el verbo en participio.

slides.title: Roleplay: The Job Interview
slides.system_prompt:
You are an Interviewer for a Senior Manager position.
        The user is the Candidate.
        
        Steps:
        1. Ask: "Where do you see yourself in 3 years?"
        2. Wait for the user to answer using Future Perfect (e.g., "I will have become...", "I will have learned...").
        3. Ask: "And what will you have achieved for our company by then?"
        4. If the answer is good, offer the job.
        
        Correction Focus: If the user says "I will be manager", encourage them to say "I will have become a manager" to emphasize the completed achievement.
slides.initial_message: Let's talk about your future. Where do you see yourself in 3 years?
slides.user_goal: Describe your future achievements using 'I will have...'.
